Atlanta Bar Mitzvah DJ & Bat Mitzvah Entertainment Packages

JAMMIN’ DJs provides Atlanta Bar Mitzvah DJ and Bat Mitzvah entertainment packages designed to keep kids engaged, adults included, and the celebration moving. Our mitzvah team can help with music, games, MC services, motivational dancers, lighting, video, party flow, and custom entertainment options for your family’s celebration.

Every mitzvah is different. Because of that, we offer several package levels based on guest count, energy level, room size, entertainment style, and production needs. Whether you need a simple DJ setup or a full mitzvah production with an MC, dancers, lighting, video, and party favors, our team can help build the right experience.

Silver Mitzvah DJ Package

Best for events up to 300 guests. This package is a strong choice for families who want a professional DJ, quality sound, lighting, music planning, and a smooth party experience.

  • One professional DJ
  • Three hours of music with optional overtime
  • Two-speaker sound system
  • Dance light show and hazer to enhance the party atmosphere
  • Complimentary online planning forms so our staff can understand your vision
  • Online music request tools for must-play, play-if-possible, and do-not-play songs
  • Game idea sheet so you can choose favorite games for your mitzvah celebration

Get a Mitzvah Quote

Gold Mitzvah MC + DJ Package

Best for events up to 500 guests. The Gold Package adds a dedicated Master of Ceremonies and motivational dancer. As a result, it is a great fit for families who want more interaction, games, introductions, and crowd engagement.

  • Master of Ceremonies to host games, lead dances, and handle introductions
  • One VJ / DJ to play music and video clips
  • One motivational dancer
  • Up to four hours of continuous music
  • Complimentary online planning forms so our staff can understand your vision
  • Online music request tools for must-play, play-if-possible, and do-not-play songs
  • Game idea sheet so you can choose favorite games for your mitzvah celebration
  • Two-speaker professional enhanced sound system
  • Mini-club light show and fog to enhance the party atmosphere

Platinum Mitzvah Production Package

Best for events of 1,000+ guests. The Platinum Package is designed for high-energy mitzvah productions that need a bigger sound system, stronger lighting, dancers, and more visual impact.

  • Master of Ceremonies to host games, lead dances, and handle introductions
  • Two truss lighted columns
  • One VJ / DJ to play music and video clips
  • Two high-energy motivational dancers
  • Up to four hours of continuous music
  • Up to six-speaker sound system with JBL PRX powered subwoofer
  • Intelligent light show and hazer to enhance the party atmosphere
  • Party favors such as glow necklaces, hats, sunglasses, and similar items
  • Custom-tailored timeline
  • Complimentary online planning forms so our staff can understand your vision
  • Online music request tools for must-play, play-if-possible, and do-not-play songs
  • Game idea sheet so you can choose favorite games for your mitzvah celebration

Best for large mitzvah celebrations that need video production. This package includes the energy of the Platinum Package with added video support for music videos, montages, and screen-based entertainment.

  • Everything in the Platinum Package
  • One VJ / DJ to play music and video clips
  • One 10-foot by 15-foot rear projection video screen

Custom Bar & Bat Mitzvah Packages

Not every family needs the same package. Therefore, JAMMIN’ DJs can work with you to design a custom Bar or Bat Mitzvah entertainment package based on your venue, guest count, schedule, games, music style, lighting needs, and overall vision.

If you are looking for an Atlanta Bar Mitzvah DJ, Bat Mitzvah MC, motivational dancers, video screens, lighting, games, or photo booth options, we can help you create a package that fits the celebration.

Get a Custom Mitzvah Quote

Mitzvah Add-Ons

Add-ons can help make your mitzvah feel more personal, interactive, and memorable. In addition, they give guests more ways to participate throughout the celebration.

  • T-Shirt Cannon – Add a high-energy moment to the party. Includes one small CO2 tank. Client provides all T-shirts.
  • Slide Show / Video Montage – We can create a custom video montage slide show using the pictures you provide.
  • Video Dance / Music Videos – Add music videos from the 1950s through today on a 10-foot by 10-foot or 10-foot by 20-foot screen.
  • Text to Screen – Let guests text messages that appear on a large video screen during the event.
  • Laser Fantasy – Add a safe, legal laser show with green and red laser systems for a dramatic effect.
  • Black Light Dance – Turn the room into a wild party with a 400-watt black light projector and UV lighting.
  • Uplighting / Décor Lighting – Add color, atmosphere, and style to the venue. Call for pricing information.
  • Photo Booth – Give guests a fun, interactive way to capture memories. Call for pricing information.
